## khive (Remote)

khive is a hosted MCP server that gives agents a memory and a knowledge graph that last across sessions and clients, one store per workspace. Agents save and recall memories by meaning (`remember`, `recall_memories`), record entities and typed links between them (`create_record`, `link_records`), walk the graph (`graph_neighbors`, `graph_context`) and keep tasks (`add_task`, `list_tasks`). Clients connect over streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1, or send an API key as `Authorization: ApiKey <key>`. The hosted service is paid, with no free tier: plans start at $8 a month, and Plus ($25 a month) on monthly billing starts with a 14-day trial, card required. The engine is open source (Apache-2.0) at github.com/ohdearquant/khive; run locally, it serves one `request` tool over stdio instead of these named tools.
